     : forall (R : reals.Real.type) (G : Kernel.MathCompCouplingGluing R)
         (E : Type -> Type) (A B : Type) (mu : Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R A)
         (f : A -> B),
       @PEutt.peutt E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
         (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) (@Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasureCoreLaws R G)
         (NativeLaws.MathCompNativeMixedMeasure R) (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticOmega R) B B
         (@eq B)
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.ProbF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B
               (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B) A mu
               (fun x : A =>
                {|
                  PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @PTreeDefinition.RetF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B
                      (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B)
                      (f x)
                |})
         |}
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.ProbF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B
               (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B) B
               (@Measure.sem_bind (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
                  (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) A B mu
                  (fun x : A =>
                   @Measure.sem_ret (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R)
                     (Measure.MathCompNodeSemanticMeasure R) B (f x)))
               (fun a : B =>
                {|
                  PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @PTreeDefinition.RetF E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B
                      (PTreeDefinition.ptree E (Kernel.MathCompKernelMeasure R) B) a
                |})
         |}
